name: usage-wrapup
description: When your plan usage gets low, tells every running agent to wrap up before the limit cuts it off, and compacts the conversation when usage is nearly gone.

threshold.title: Wrap-up threshold (% left)
threshold.description: Tell agents to finish when this much of a usage window is left.

compactFiveHour.title: Compact at 5-hour usage (% used)
compactFiveHour.description: Compact the conversation once per 5-hour window when this much of it is used.

compactSevenDay.title: Compact at weekly usage (% used)
compactSevenDay.description: Compact the conversation once per weekly window when this much of it is used.
